verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no sandbox or test environment for YYLO Ledger data that lets an agent work without touching real records. The isolated configuration directory in docs-2 is for validating an unpublished skills checkout without changing normal agent settings. That is an adjacent install-testing workaround that relies on the host agent's config, not a data sandbox. Project routing with --project and soft-delete archiving likewise do not provide a non-production environment.
